verse.verse_1: Woe to every (kind of) scandal-monger and-backbiter,
verse.verse_2: Who pileth up wealth and layeth it by,
verse.verse_3: Thinking that his wealth would make him last for ever!
verse.verse_4: By no means! He will be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces,
verse.verse_5: And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces?
verse.verse_6: (It is) the Fire of (the Wrath of) Allah kindled (to a blaze),
verse.verse_7: The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts:
verse.verse_8: It shall be made into a vault over them,
